amazon_password = [x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='amazon'][0]
username = 'william_mart@gmail.com'
login = apis.amazon.login(username=username, password=amazon_password)
print(login)

# Step 1: Fetch wishlist and identify mouse pads
wish = apis.amazon.show_wish_list(access_token=login['access_token'])
print('wishlist_count', len(wish))
# Inspect items
for i, item in enumerate(wish):
    print(i, item.get('product_id'), item.get('product_name'), '| type:', item.get('product_type'), '| qty:', item.get('quantity'), '| inventory:', item.get('inventory_quantity'))

# Filter mouse pads by name/type keywords
import re

def is_mouse_pad(x):
    name = (x.get('product_name') or '').lower()
    ptype = (x.get('product_type') or '').lower()
    s = name + ' ' + ptype
    # match common variants
    return any(kw in s for kw in ['mouse pad', 'mousepad', 'mouse mat', 'desk pad'])

mouse_pads = [x for x in wish if is_mouse_pad(x)]
print('mouse_pads_count', len(mouse_pads))
for i, item in enumerate(mouse_pads):
    print('mouse', i, item.get('product_id'), item.get('product_name'), '| type:', item.get('product_type'), '| qty:', item.get('quantity'))
